notes: The AMX-8952 is an openGear modular card (not a standalone chassis) that occupies 2 slots in an OG3-FR/OGX-FR frame; it is desktop/rack-agnostic (rackUnits omitted since it is a frame card, not a self-contained rack unit) and draws power from the shared frame midplane/backplane, so there is no discrete AC/DC power connector on the product itself (omitted from ports). Physical connectors live on a separate rear module (sold separately, e.g. 8322AR-329/8322AR-329A for AMX-8952-A), not on the card edge. Three sibling SKUs exist with identical 3x SDI BNC (1 dedicated in, 1 dedicated out, 1 bidirectional) but different audio I/O: AMX-8952-A (documented here) = 8 unbalanced AES3 pairs on HD-BNC; AMX-8952-B = 8 balanced AES3 pairs on 3-pin WECO connectors (110 ohm); AMX-8952-C = 8 channels of balanced analog audio on 3-pin WECO connectors. All three share identical SDI and GPIO connectivity. GPIO 3-pin WECO terminal blocks do not exactly match any id in the allowed connector list; 'euroblock' was chosen as the closest pluggable-terminal-block analog. 12G-SDI (UHD 2160p) support requires the separately licensed AMX-8952-UHD-LICENSE; without it the card is HD/3G-SDI only, so sdi-12g grade reflects licensed capability of the hardware, not default-shipped behavior. Source: official Ross Video AMX-8952-A/B/C User Guide (Rev 5, May 19 2026), cross-checked against the Ross Video product page and Markertek/DigiNet retailer listings, all of which agree on the 3-SDI-BNC + 8-audio-channel + 2-GPIO architecture and HD/3G/12G-SDI support.

ports.name: SDI IN
ports.note: HD-BNC on rear module; accommodates SMPTE 292M/424M/ST-2081/ST-2082 up to 11.88Gbps; 12G (UHD) requires AMX-8952-UHD-LICENSE

ports.name: SDI OUT
ports.note: HD-BNC on rear module; 12G (UHD) requires AMX-8952-UHD-LICENSE

ports.name: SDI BI-DIR
ports.note: Configurable as input or output via DashBoard; 12G (UHD) requires AMX-8952-UHD-LICENSE

ports.name: AES 1
ports.note: Unbalanced 75-ohm AES3/AES-3id on HD-BNC; card interface is bidirectional (embed or de-embed)

ports.name: GPIO 1
ports.note: 3-pin WECO-style pluggable terminal block; user-programmable per-pin as GPI (input, contact closure) or Tally (output). Closest listed connector id to the 3-pin WECO connector actually used.

ports.name: GPIO 2
ports.note: 3-pin WECO-style pluggable terminal block; user-programmable per-pin as GPI or Tally
